title: Halfweg Sugar Factory
geometryBasis: BAG-derived OpenStreetMap contours and Dutch national 0.5-metre surface heights fix the two silos. The lime kiln is independently located in the same surface survey and the operator catalog.
sectionBasis: The architect documents the stripped ground-floor structure, silver-gray aluminum drums and diagonal field of diamond glazing. The Qualla original shows a newly clad silo and the lime kiln before the redevelopment was finished.
limitations: This entry represents the retained skyline structures. The neighboring event hall, mall and smaller factory buildings are outside the authored scope.
Roof levels and centers use the national surface survey. The exact window mosaic, exposed base structures and kiln platforms are estimated from the public-domain photo and architect’s description.
